requirements.text: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Aerospace, Systems, or a related technical field.
Coursework or practical experience in data structures, algorithms, and software development fundamentals.
Demonstrated proficiency in a programming language (e.g., Python, C++, Rust).
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to break down problems, test assumptions, and work through bugs.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with an ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative team environment.
Previous internship or co-op experience or experience on a software engineering team
Knowledge of a specific satellite subsystem or domain, such as orbital mechanics, RF communications, or power systems
Previous experience building and deploying SaaS applications on IaaS platforms
Previous experience building or training ML models
Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL/HITL) testing or system integration.

Muon is a fast growing company which offers interns the experience to get direct mentorship and have real impact on our programs. You'll collaborate with a dynamic team in a startup environment and have the chance to learn from some of the most accomplished and experienced aerospace professionals in the industry, in an experience where your decisions and contributions play a pivotal role in driving Muon's success. Summer internships will range between the months of May and September depending on university schedules, and the internship is full-time and on-site in Mountain View or San Jose, CA.
